title: A Gravity for the Orbit
author: Marguerite Fairweather
blurb: Quentin Winterbourne, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
